verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an agent-sandbox platform, but the pack never documents a self-hosted deployment. The probe describes Sandbox0 as providing "managed AI agent sandboxes," and the docs and pricing cover only the hosted service. Qualifiers like "On Sandbox0 Cloud" hint at another deployment mode but do not document one, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
